{{Quote|Others, like Senator R'shinnos Sh'neel (Genassa), are reserving judgment until further developments.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_1.html|Palpatine to Separatists: Let's Talk}}</ref>}}
'''Genassa''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[M'shinn]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which evolved from a [[M'shinn precursor species|humanoid precursor species]] that had entered a symbiotic relationship with a local [[M'shinn plant species|plant species]]. The M'shinni eventually [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] [[Genassa's moon]] and the rest of the [[Genassa system/Legends|Genassa system]] before going on to develop [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and settle [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] at some point by [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, Genassa had become a member world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and it subsequently became incorporated into the territories of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
Genassa was a terrestrial<ref name="Mask" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|330|Genassa}}</ref> located in the [[Genassa system/Legends|Genassa system]], a part of the [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by a [[Genassa's moon|large moon]]. At some point, the planet's [[Plant/Legends|flora]] included a [[M'shinn plant species|plant species]] that eventually&mdash;long before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]&mdash;entered into a symbiotic relationship with a [[M'shinn precursor species|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], which ultimately went extinct, evolving into the plant-covered, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[M'shinn]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GG12" />

==History==
===Joining the Republic===
[[File:Mshinni.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Genassa was the homeworld of the M'shinn species.]]
At some point, population pressures on Genassa forced the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] M'shinn species to [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] outer [[Realspace/Legends|space]], beginning with the construction of [[orbital biosphere]]s and then proceeding with the settlement of Genassa's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and the [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] of the rest of the Genassa [[Star system/Legends|system's]] planets. Eventually,<ref name="GG12" /> at some point by [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]],<ref name="MshinniInterstellar">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'' establishes that the [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrillings]] first traveled off-world after the [[M'shinn]]i had [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Agriworld-2079/Legends|Agriworld-2079]]&mdash;which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places in a [[Agriworld-2079 system/Legends|star system]] other than the [[Genassa system/Legends|Genassa system]]. The ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' establishes that [[Jervo Thalien]]&mdash;whom [[Knights of the Old Republic 1|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 1]] depicts as a Skrilling&mdash;was [[Chairman/Legends|chairman]] of the off-world company [[Lhosan Industries]] by the time [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] became a member [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Since ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates the latter event to [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]], the M'shinni must have therefore acquired interstellar travel ability at some point by that date.</ref> the M'shinni developed [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], which allowed them to colonize hundreds of worlds in the M'shinni [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="GG12" />

Space surrounding Genassa was explored by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> and after being encountered by the Republic, the M'shinni quickly embraced that government,<ref name="GG12" /> with their homeworld being situated within the borders of the Republic by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> By the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[22 BBY/Legends|13:3:21]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[R'shinnos Sh'neel]] represented Genassa in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]],<ref name="HNN" /> and during the first campaigns of the Clone Wars in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the [[Ninth Army]] of the Republic was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Genassa's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" />

===Empire and beyond===
The planet was incorporated into the territory of the Galactic Empire by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> During the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group known as the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]] planned to attack a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of the criminal organization known as the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] as part of a feud between the two groups. The ambush was supposed to take place in an isolated region of space between Genassa and the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where [[Starship/Legends|starships]] frequently emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] for [[Navigator/Legends|navigational]] calculations.<ref name="Mask" />

{{RPG|''[[Mask of the Pirate Queen]]''}}
However, a group of individuals hired by the Zann Consortium to track down and eliminate the leader of the Veiled Sorority, the [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]], managed to obtain information about the planned attack and its coordinates. They relayed that information to the Zann Consortium, which subsequently set up an [[Battle between Ord Mantell and Genassa|ambush]] of its own there.<ref name="Mask" />
{{Endgame}}

By [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Genassa had become a part of the Empire's eventual successor state, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" /> [[27 ABY/Legends|Fourteen years]] later, the Genassa system had been conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species as part of its [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It remained under the invaders' control until [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|M'shinn}}
Genassa was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]]<ref name="Mask" /> that was the homeworld of the sentient M'shinn species. The M'shinni society was organized around families known as [[Rootline]]s, with each M'shinni-controlled world having a [[Council of the Wise]] that consisted of the eldest member of each Rootline on that world. The Councils of the Wise enforced ancient land ownership rules and concerned themselves with how the M'shinni society interacted with the Galactic Empire.<ref name="GG12" /> Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the Genassa system numbered between one and ten billion.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GenassaOnCelanonSpur-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A number of maps of the galaxy published in several ''Star Wars'' sources placed Genassa on the Celanon Spur.]]
Genassa was first mentioned in the [[1995]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', in an entry authored by [[Lisa Smedman]].<ref name="GG12" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the Genassa system, and therefore the planet itself, in grid square M-7. In the book, a number of [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] maps depict Genassa between the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel]] and [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega systems]] on the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]].<ref name="TEA" /> That placement was later repeated in several maps in other sources.<ref name="EGTW" /><ref name="EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref><ref name="FF">''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Collector's Guide & Galaxy Chart]]''</ref><ref name="Podracing">{{SW|url=news/this-is-podracing-sports-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-part-1|series=Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|text=Part 1: This Is Podracing|nolive=1}}</ref><ref name="AoRCR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref><ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

However, in a map of ''The Essential Atlas'' focusing on Genassa's galactic region, the Mid Rim, its [[Star/Legends|star]] system is instead placed a relatively short distance off that segment of the Celanon Spur<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;a placement that was also repeated in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book<ref name="Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> as well as in a smaller-scale map in Jason Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' focusing on Genassa's galactic neighborhood. This article assumes that the placement originating from these latter, more specific maps is correct.<ref name="EGTW" />
